carapace.scale_convention: Rostral tips to posterior carapace edge, excluding eyes, limbs and exposed pleon. Main shell and bifid rostrum together span the published nominal holotype carapace length. Soft depth interpreted.

interpretation: Evidence-informed living reconstruction at the nominal holotype carapace length 8.5 mm and width 5.2 mm. Body depth, color and static spread-swimming posture are interpretive. Simplified sex-neutral pleon and superficial mouthparts do not claim reproductive or internal microanatomy. Mid-Cretaceous, not Cambrian.
